text.tspan: Wind energy generation vs. installed capacity 2025
Wind energy generation, measured in gigawatt-hours (GWh) versus cumulative installed wind energy capacity,
measured in gigawatts (GW). Data includes energy from both onshore and offshore wind sources.
Wind capacity (gigawatts; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Wind generation (gigawatt-hours; plotted on a logarithmic axis)

tspan.tspan: Energy Institute - Statistical Review of World Energy (2026); IRENA (2026)
